items.title: 2.5 Python Modules and Built-in Data Structures (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Data structure
blocks.text: Data structure data ko munazzam karne aur rakhne ka khaas tareeqa hai; list is ki ek misal hai. Python ki standard library mein bohat se built-in modules aur data structures hain.
Yeh hissa functions, modules aur libraries, aur agla hissa Python ke built-in data structures batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Data structure kya hai? Misal dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Data ko munazzam aur mehfooz rakhne ka tareeqa ta ke kaarkardagi se istemal ho, jaise list.

items: Data structure: data munazzam karne ka andaaz (list); Python ki standard library mein bohat se modules aur structures.
